_note: Re-derived 2026-08-03 against the thirteen checker-passed stacks and the six applied swaps. The previous file declared four kills built on Blowfly Infestation and Carnifex Demon (both now cut), required a self-shrinking body for the Mikaeus line that stack 010 disproved, and omitted the Phyrexian Altar loop entirely. Each kill target names the stack that verified it; each any_of group is the redundancy deck-audit prices through the hypergeometric.
